summary.overview: In the recent Product Discussion and Sales Meeting between Danny and Andy, the focus was on the new DL Engines Launchpad Offer, which provides clients with access to the LIPS (LinkedIn prospecting system) to facilitate campaign management and prospecting. Key features include tailored campaign creation, a kickoff call for clients, and 24/7 support. The discussion revealed that clients typically receive between 20-40% acceptance on connection requests, with an average of 5-10 meaningful responses per week. Clients can book calls with prospects through the system, with an upgrade option available for enhanced support from a dedicated Marketing Assistant. Regular campaign oversight and monthly performance reviews are included, allowing clients to suggest changes. The pricing for the service ranges from £500 to £650, and Andrew expressed interest in signing up and starting his campaign. Action items include documenting the offer details and initiating Andrew's campaign.
summary.short_summary: In a recent meeting, Danny and Andy discussed the new DL Engines Launchpad Offer, which provides clients access to the LinkedIn prospecting system (LIPS). Key features include tailored campaign creation, a kickoff call for clients, and 24/7 support via email and Slack. Clients typically see a 20-40% acceptance rate on connection requests, averaging 5-10 meaningful responses weekly. They can manage conversations and book calls with prospects directly through the system, with an option to upgrade for enhanced support from a dedicated Marketing Assistant. The offer includes daily campaign oversight and monthly performance reviews, allowing clients to suggest changes. Pricing ranges from £500 to £650, and Andrew expressed interest in signing up and starting his campaign, leading to action items for documentation and initiation of his campaign.
